links.outcome: Accuracy of LLMs on ophthalmology exam-style questions versus real clinical competence
links.effect: Gemini-Pro-3 95.8% accuracy; all other models significantly lower adjusted odds of correct response; accuracy declined with difficulty. Authors note real-world clinical scenarios still needed.
links.quote: These findings suggest that a clinical specialization LLM does not guarantee superior performance in ophthalmic knowledge, and further studies using real-world clinical scenarios are needed to evaluate LLM-based systems in ophthalmology.

links.outcome: Calibration and confidence-based discrimination of LLM outputs
links.effect: Gemini-Pro-3 best calibration; Claude-Opus-4.6 and ChatGPT-5.4-Pro strongest confidence-based discrimination; calibration varied across models.
links.quote: Gemini-Pro-3 showed the best calibration, whereas Claude-Opus-4.6 and ChatGPT-5.4-Pro showed the strongest confidence-based discrimination.

screen.reason: Evaluates the performance, calibration, and discrimination of several LLMs on OKAP-style ophthalmology questions without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
